situation: My partner cheated on me and now I am extremely sad.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am feeling very sad

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am very sorry to hear that. What are you sad about?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: My partner of 9 months cheated on me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh wow that is really rough. Do you think you might be able to work it out or is it over permanently?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It is over permanently...

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Maybe it is for the best - I have been cheated on before and although it hurt at the time it turned out to be the best favour he could have done me.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeah I guess, the relationship was a little toxic and she sometimes only used me for money.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maybe is it for the best now that I think about it.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Sounds like you're definitely well off out of that one!!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeah I just miss having someone there for me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: All you need now is to give yourself some TLC .. treat yourself to something nice and go easy on yourself.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: What is TLC

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: There will be someone else. I never thought I'd find anyone else but I did and we've been together ten years ago now!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Tender Loving Care :) Means be good to yourself

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Ok yeah your story is very inspirational to me. Maybe this was needed in order to find the right person

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Is there anything you can do to distract yourself right now? Plan a holiday or take a night class or something?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am now doing mturk to get my mind off of it to make some extra money

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Save up what you make and buy yourself something nice?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: yeah the only problem is I am barely getting any money from this

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Do you have any tips onto how I can make more money/

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: There is some very lucrative stuff out there :). Take what we are doing right now for instance.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I mean 15 minutes for 2$ doesn't seem very lucrative

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: but I guess it ads up

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: beats flipping burgers ;). So, what are you going to do to get yourself back onto the dating market?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am going to wait for this whole covid thing to end and then get a real job and once I fix my financial situation I will start dating again

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah yes, the world feels like it's on hold at the moment doesn't it? Probably not a good time to start sharing germs with new people :D

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeah exactly and I have more pressing matters at hand than a girlfriend because like I said, I am in need of money right now since

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I'll be around for ages if you want to talk some more on here!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I think talking to you has benefited me a lot so thank you for that

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am feeling happy right now

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You're welcome :) I have a solution for every problem you know ;)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeah thats what it seems like

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: how can I make sure you get the most money from this

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: just wait till fifteen mins is up ;). If we quit before then we get less. So, um, tell me about your ex?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: ok got it

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I met my ex through tinder

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: and then we started going on dates and we both seemed to like each other

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: ah! I met mine through OKCUPID. Online dating is definitely the way to go these days

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: yeah it really makes it easy to meet new people

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Not like when I was younger when the internet was just taking off. Internet dating was seen as weird then

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Well it's been lovely talking, I hope to see you again sometime :) take care!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Bye
